description: Republish (full-replace) an existing multi-file BrewPage site in place at the SAME URL/ID. Requires owner token. The uploaded bundle becomes the complete new file set — files absent from it are removed, new files added, matching files overwritten. Single-page: pass `entryContent`. Multi-page: pass `files` (array of `{path, content}`). Optional `entry` overrides the default `index.html`.

entryContent.description: HTML content for a single-page site (entry file). Mutually exclusive with `files`.

files.description: Multi-file site: array of `{path, content}`. Mutually exclusive with `entryContent`.

ownerToken.description: Owner token received when the site was created (required for republish)

tags.description: Optional tags (replaces the site's existing tags)

ttlDays.description: Time to live in days (1-30, default: 15)

name: republish_site
